subject: martha_williamson_1904

silhouette.what: Silhouette and fit of the clothes
silhouette.note: Reshot 2026-11-07 after T-3434: the shirtwaist pouches over the waist band with full upper sleeves, and the bib has straps over the shoulders; pale shirtwaist, white apron and dark skirt to the ground read as the 1903 pictures do at 3 m and 10 m.

folds.note: Kevin accepted the figure on 2026-11-07 ("yes she looks pretty good"). The shirtwaist's pouch and the sleeves' fullness carry the gathers; the skirt has no flounces and the apron no ruffles, which the pictures show at a few metres.

hat_hair.note: Reshot 2026-11-07 after T-3434: a cleared woman's hairstyle, drawn back smooth from the face to a round bun behind, dark brown; the pictures show working women's hair drawn up off the face to a knot.

skin.note: Monochrome prints; face and hands only, and her complexion is not recorded.

hands.note: Hands loosely clasped in front at the waist or held behind (T-3434), never sinking into the skirt; the pictures have them at work on the table.

stance.what: How the figure stands or sits
stance.note: Upright, feet together under the skirt, as the women stand at the table.

motion.note: A standing idle: small weight shifts and the head turning; she nods to a visitor rather than touching her brow. The pictures are stills.

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever laid the stills beside the pictures; each checklist item is {what, status, note} with status open | reads | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling — open when a visitor would see the figure is not the pictures’ kind of person in that respect. The first figure of each role is the owner’s call (the plan’s "Your call"); later figures of the role are held to the one he approved. A reshoot of a changed figure (bound) sets the verdict back to unreviewed.
